questions.q: What is the film "Death Camp in Karašok" about?
o: The suffering of Serbs in Norway during World War II
questions.e: In the video: "film... koji govori o stradalim Srbima tokom Drugog svetskog rata u Norveškoj" — a film... about the Serbs who suffered in Norway during World War II.

questions.q: How many people from the territory of the former Yugoslavia were taken to Norway?
questions.e: In the video: "više od 4.000 ljudi sa teritorije bivše Jugoslavije... odvedeno u Norvešku" — more than 4,000 people from the territory of the former Yugoslavia... were taken to Norway.

questions.q: What share of the prisoners did not return home?
questions.e: In the video: "više od polovine nije se vratilo kući" — more than half did not return home.

questions.q: Where is the film's director from?
questions.e: In the video: "režiser filma iz Norveške, Šetil Palmkvist" — the film's director from Norway, Sjetil Palmkvist.

questions.q: Which camp in Niš are they filming?
questions.e: In the video: "snimati po drugi put logor Crveni krst. Odavde je veliki broj logoraša zapravo poslat u smrt, u Norvešku." — to film the Red Cross camp for the second time. From here a large number of prisoners were actually sent to their deaths, in Norway.

questions.q: What percentage of those who died in the camps in Norway were Serbs?
questions.e: In the video: "preko 95% stradalih u logorima u Norveškoj zapravo bili Srbi" — over 95% of those who died in the camps in Norway were in fact Serbs.

questions.q: What was the camp in Karašok like?
o: An open-type camp, cold down to minus 50, torment by the guards
questions.e: In the video: "Logori u Karašoku su bili otvorenog tipa. Temperatura od minus 50 stepeni... brutalnih mučenja od strane stražara" — the camps in Karašok were of the open type. Temperatures of minus 50 degrees... brutal torture by the guards.

questions.q: When do they plan to finish the film?
o: Next summer — for the 80th anniversary of the prisoners' deaths
questions.e: In the video: "Plan je da se film završi sledeće godine na leto, jer u junu... 80 godina od stradanja" — the plan is to finish the film next summer, because in June... it will be 80 years since the suffering.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: *Logor* smrti u Karašoku.
questions.e: Logor — a camp.

questions.q: Intervjui sa direktnim *očevicima* ovih stradanja.
questions.e: Očevidac — an eyewitness; oči — eyes, vidjeti — to see.

questions.q: Na nama je zadatak da to sačuvamo od *zaborava*.
questions.e: Zaborav — oblivion; zaboraviti — to forget.

questions.q: Da ne zaborave stradanje svojih *predaka*.
questions.e: Predak — an ancestor.

questions.q: Veliki broj *potomaka* se javio.
questions.e: Potomak — a descendant.

questions.q: Bilo je brutalnih *mučenja*.
questions.e: Mučenje — torture, torment.

questions.q: Od strane *stražara*.
questions.e: Stražar — a guard, a watchman.

questions.q: Položili smo *venac* zahvalnosti na njegovom grobu.
questions.e: Venac — a wreath.

questions.q: U toku je snimanje ___.
questions.e: Snimanje of what? Genitive case: snimanje filma.

questions.q: Film govori o stradalim ___ tokom Drugog svetskog rata.
questions.e: O in answer to "about whom?" requires the locative case: o Srbima.

questions.q: Od 2008. ste u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u Norveškoj.

questions.q: Više od 4.000 ljudi je odvedeno u ___.
questions.e: Odvesti u + accusative case: u Norvešku.

questions.q: Đorđe Bojanić je istoričar iz ___.
questions.e: Iz ("from") requires the genitive case: iz Niša.

questions.q: Temperatura od minus 50 ___.
questions.e: After the number 50 the genitive plural is used: stepeni.

questions.q: Ljudi sa vrlo malo ___ na sebi.
questions.e: After malo ("little") the genitive case is used: malo odeće.

questions.q: Oni koji nisu mogli da odgovore ___ koji su postavljeni, bili su ubijani.
questions.e: Odgovoriti to what — dative case: zadacima.
